This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

3. The present application has been filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. by the Petitioner seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Laxmisagar P.S. Case No.311 of 2023, corresponding to C.T. Case No.719 of 2023, pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C.-IV, Bhubaneswar, for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 294/420/506/34 of the I.P.C.
4.
In course of hearing of the bail application, learned counsels for the parties agreed that the Petitioner shall return initially a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- to the Informant.
Thereafter, the balance amount of Rs.4,50,000/- shall be returned in six monthly instalments for a period of six months.
Initially amount of Rs.1,00,000/- shall be paid by Monday.

In such view of the matter, since both sides agreed for such proposal, this Court deems it proper to dispose of the anticipatory bail application by directing the Petitioner to surrender before the Court in seisin over the matter within three weeks from today and move an application for bail.

In such eventuality, the court in seisin over the matter shall release her on bail in connection with the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
While releasing the Petitioner on bail, the court in seisin over the matter shall impose the aforesaid agreement between the parties as one of the conditions.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
6. Accordingly, the ABLAPL is disposed of.
